jobs.occupation: Grid Connection und Electrical Integration Manager (f/m/d) (Starkstrommonteur/in)
jobs.description:
E.ON Energy Projects GmbH (EEP) designs, finances, builds, operates and optimises decentralised, large-scale power generation plants for industrial customers. Since 2000, we realised projects of more than 1 gigawatt across Europe. With our bespoke integrated solutions, we drive decarbonisation and digitalisation in the energy-intensive industries.
At E.ON diversity matters. We welcome all people and are convinced that differences make us stronger. Become part of our inclusive and diverse company culture! To create equal opportunities for everyone we offer our positions in full- or part-time.
Ready to become a Playmaker of the energy transition? Join our team in München and apply online as Grid Connection und Electrical Integration Manager (f/m/d). Are you brave enough to drive progress and forge new paths? Let’s make it work and create real impact together. We can’t wait to meet you! It’s on us, to make new energy work.

Responsibilities

- Assure the quality of the electrical integration for utility-scale BESS projects (incl. grid connection certification)
- Act as the key technical integrator in projects between EIS, TSOs/DSOs, EPC contractors, OEMs, and engineering consultants
- Coordinate interfaces between substations, HV/MV equipment, protection systems, SCADA, EMS, and BESS assets
- Ensure requirements towards substation (until grid integration EPCs are complete) and manage technical quality at interface with EPC
- Review engineering deliverables and ensure compliance with project requirements and grid connection standards
- Support project development, procurement, construction, commissioning/energization
- Identify and mitigate technical and commercial risks
- Manage external engineering partners and EPC contractors throughout project delivery
Requirements
- Degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline, with proven experience in utility-scale BESS, renewable energy, transmission, distribution, or substation projects, from conceptual phase until commissioning/energization
- Understanding of protection, control and SCADA systems, with ability to review, challenge, and validate engineering studies, designs, and technical documentation
- Familiar with grid connection processes (incl. grid connection certification), German and other European grid connection requirements, and TSO/DSO processes
- Experience with managing EPC contractors, engineering consultancies or Owner’s Engineers, and technical interface coordination across multidisciplinary engineering teams
- Excellent problem-solving, communication, influencing, and decision-making skills, with ability to identify risks, assess implications, and drive pragmatic solutions
- Commercial awareness of project risks, priorities, cost, schedule, contractual interfaces, and delivery objectives
- Fluent in German and English (C1), with 20-40% travel flexibility
Benefits
- High flexibility: Make work fit your personal life with our hybrid working model, flexible hours, and job-sharing options
- More freedom: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave plus extra days off, and find your balance with options like a 4.5-day week, a sabbatical, extra time, or extra pay
- Workation included: Make Europe your office and work up to 20 days per year from inspiring locations across the EU
- Corporate benefits: Secure your future with benefits including company pension schemes, our share programme, a range of insurance packages, and much more
- Culture of innovation: Share your ideas and unleash creativity in a collaborative, interdisciplinary environment with flat hierarchies
- Family support: Manage family life – from paid family start leave, childcare and holiday programs, to daily assistance for family members
- Modern workplace: Enjoy a multifunctional workspace that combines cutting-edge digital technology with ergonomic comfort for productivity and collaboration
- Strong team spirit: Celebrate successes and connect with colleagues at our company and team events
- Personal growth: Unlock your potential through continuous learning, diverse development opportunities, and personalized training or mentoring
- Holistic health: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with our sports, fitness, wellness, nutrition, meditation, physiotherapy, and preventive healthcare offerings
- Individual mobility: Travel your way with flexible options such as car and bike leasing, or a subsidised Deutschlandticket for public transport
- Culinary offering: Enjoy fresh, balanced meals, snacks, and drinks at many office locations with our subsidised canteen

Do you have questions?
For further information please contact Kyra Temma, kyra.temma@eon.com. Are you already convinced that this is the next step in your career? If yes, we would be happy if you would register and apply online (Job ID 246064). Just a quick note: Please only use our official application portal to apply. Unfortunately, we can't consider applications sent via email. We really appreciate your understanding!
What you need to know:
Contract type: Permanent
Work Model: Hybrid
Working time: Full time; Part time
Company: E.ON Energy Projects GmbH
Location: München
Function area: Project/Program Management; Engineering; Renewables

Inclusion

It is important to us that people with disabilities have access to a fair application process, providing them with an opportunity to shine. Please let us know via the application form if you require technical or organisational adjustments during the application process. We will strive to make the required aids available.

jobs.occupation: Regional Enterprise Sales Director Industrial AI Transformation DACH (m/f/d) (Leiter/in - Vertrieb)
jobs.description:
Regional Enterprise Sales Director Industrial AI Transformation DACH (m/f/d)

Hybrid–Berlin | Cologne | Frankfurt | Hamburg | Hannover | Leipzig | Munich | Nuremberg | StuttgartGo To Market – Sales / Full-time / HybridRegional Enterprise Sales Director Industrial AI Transformation DACH (m/f/d)

Shape the Future of Industrial AI with Mendix and Intelligence Center X
At Mendix, a Siemens business, we are redefining how enterprises build, deploy and scale intelligent applications. As the leading low-code platform, Mendix empowers organizations to accelerate digital transformation by combining software development, AI and enterprise collaboration.
With the introduction of Intelligence Center X, Siemens is entering the next generation of Industrial AI. Intelligence Center X combines enterprise data, AI agents, knowledge graphs and intelligent applications into a secure and governed ecosystem that enables organizations to move from isolated AI initiatives to enterprise-wide transformation.
To accelerate this vision across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, we are looking for an experienced Regional Enterprise Sales Director Industrial AI Transformation DACH.
This executive leadership role combines commercial leadership, strategic market development and executive customer engagement. You will be responsible for scaling the Mendix business while establishing Intelligence Center X as the leading Industrial AI platform for enterprise customers across the region.
Your Mission
You will own the commercial strategy, market expansion and business performance for Mendix and Intelligence Center X across DACH.
Working closely with Siemens Digital Industries Software, Siemens Xcelerator, Partner Sales, Customer Success, Product Management and Services, you will build one of Siemens' fastest growing software businesses.
Your Responsibilities:Commercial Leadership

- Define and execute the regional growth strategy for Mendix and Intelligence Center X.- Deliver sustainable Annual Contract Value (ACV), ARR and new-logo growth across the DACH region.- Lead and develop high-performing Sales Directors, Enterprise Account Executives and cross-functional commercial teams.- Build a predictable, data-driven sales organization focused on operational excellence and execution.- Establish executive business reviews, forecasting discipline and performance management frameworks.

Industrial AI Market Development

- Position Intelligence Center X as the strategic Industrial AI platform for enterprise customers.- Help customers evolve from isolated AI pilots toward enterprise-wide AI transformation.- Drive executive conversations around AI, Digital Engineering, Digital Manufacturing, Digital Thread and Enterprise Transformation.- Develop strategic industry plays and AI transformation programs for Manufacturing, Automotive, Energy, Life Sciences, Infrastructure and Process Industries.- Expand Mendix as the preferred platform for intelligent applications, AI copilots and agent-based business processes.

Executive Customer Engagement

- Build trusted relationships with CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, Chief Digital Officers and business executives.- Support strategic enterprise opportunities through executive sponsorship and value-based selling.- Participate directly in key customer engagements and complex negotiations.- Position Siemens as a strategic transformation partner beyond traditional software sales.

Ecosystem Leadership

- Collaborate across Siemens Digital Industries Software, Siemens Xcelerator, AI Studio, Graph Studio and Partner organizations.- Build strong relationships with Global System Integrators, consulting partners and technology alliances.- Develop joint go-to-market initiatives that accelerate Industrial AI adoption.- Represent Mendix and Intelligence Center X at executive events, customer forums and industry conferences.

Intelligence-Driven Business Management

- Leverage customer, market and competitive intelligence to identify growth opportunities.- Build executive dashboards and business insights to improve forecasting, pipeline health and commercial performance.- Translate customer feedback into product innovation together with Product Management.- Establish scalable sales methodologies, industry playbooks and best practices across the region.

Leadership & Culture

- Inspire, coach and develop diverse, high-performing teams.- Foster an inclusive, collaborative and customer-centric culture.- Encourage innovation, continuous learning and experimentation.- Build future sales leaders capable of driving the next generation of Industrial AI transformation.

What You'll Bring:- Extensive executive sales leadership experience within Enterprise Software, SaaS or Industrial Software.- Proven success building and scaling high-growth enterprise businesses across the DACH region.- Strong experience leading second-line sales organizations.- Track record of exceeding revenue targets while developing high-performing commercial teams.- Experience engaging C-level executives on strategic transformation initiatives.- Deep understanding of Digital Transformation, AI, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Platforms or Industrial Software.- Strong analytical capabilities with experience leveraging business intelligence and data-driven decision making.- Experience working within complex matrix organizations and global ecosystems.- Outstanding executive communication, presentation and negotiation skills.- Fluent German and English.

Preferred Experience:- Industrial AI- Low-Code / No-Code Platforms- Enterprise Applications- Manufacturing Digitalization- Siemens Xcelerator Ecosystem- AI Governance- Enterprise Architecture- Platform Business Models- Digital Engineering- Digital Manufacturing- Agentic AI- Knowledge Graphs- Enterprise Data Platforms

What Success Looks Like:Within your first 24 months you will have:

- Significantly accelerated Mendix growth across DACH.- Established Intelligence Center X as a strategic Industrial AI platform within key enterprise accounts.- Built one of the highest-performing enterprise software organizations within Siemens.- Expanded strategic relationships with executive customers and partners.- Created a scalable commercial operating model supporting long-term double-digit growth.- Positioned Mendix as the application platform connecting AI, enterprise data and business processes across the Siemens Xcelerator ecosystem.

Why Join Us?
This is more than a regional sales leadership position.
It is an opportunity to shape how Industrial AI is adopted across Europe's largest industrial economy. You will influence executive transformation agendas, build the next generation of enterprise software growth and help define the future of intelligent enterprises together with Siemens and Mendix.
If you are passionate about combining commercial excellence, transformational leadership and Industrial AI innovation, we invite you to join us in building the future.
Our Benefits & Rewards
The total cash compensation range for this position is €174,600 to €349,300 with 40% of this being comprised of an annual incentive target (100% achievement). The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/ (https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/)
Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion
We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

Intern in Space-Software Unit Testing & Migration (d/f/m)

Are you looking for an internship and want to get to know the work of a Satellite Software Engineer (d/f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Space Systems On-Board Software as an intern (d/f/m)!

- Location: Immenstaad/Friedrichshafen
- Start: 01.12.2026

Your location

At the Airbus site in Friedrichshafen you will be working on innovation where others spend their holidays. Enjoy panoramic views of Lake Constance while having lunch in our canteen. And after work, join one of our many corporate sports groups to go running, sailing or skiing.

- You will explore the use of AI agents to automatically create and implement new unit tests with Unity/CMock.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled fulltime student (d/f/m) in a degree program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
- Good knowledge of the C programming language (ideally in an embedded environment).
- Prior experience with unit testing frameworks (e.g., Unity, Cmock, Google Test) is advantageous.

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support the development department, Airbus Helicopters is looking for a

Mechanical Engineer for Helicopter Maintenance Design (d/m/w)

This position is located in Airbus Helicopters Design Office organisation within the Maintenance and Ground Operations department. You will work within this department (approximately 70 employees, spread across Marignane and Donauwörth) and be responsible for helicopter prototype maintenance programs and in-service major incidents (linked to maintenance) on various H/C programs (civil/military).

** Our Benefits for You**

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Tasks and responsibilities

Upon assuming this position, you will be responsible for the following operational and technical activities:

Helicopter Prototype maintenance:

- Accountable for all Design Office prototype maintenance instructions.
- Analyse and validate Design Office prototype Maintenance Technical Notes.
- Responsible for organizing and driving prototype Maintenance Technical Notes updates.
- Ensure all processes and maintenance documentation comply with the established BlueSky policy.
- Serve as the bridge between Design Office, Prototype Flight Crew and Prototype Shop.

In-Service Major Incidents:

- Contribute to investigation on incident/accident linked to maintenance operations.
- Support Major Incident treatment activities and protect in-service maintenance burden.
- Analyse maintenance procedures.
- Organise maintenance validation tests.
- Contribute to Aviation & Safety roadmap.
- Maintainability analysis to check accessibility & feasibility of maintenance tasks and compliance to helicopter maintenance policy.
- Ergonomic and Human Factors analysis to reduce maintenance errors and risks for operators and helicopters.
- Influence system design and integration to ensure compliance to maintenance policy & requirements.
- Propose alternative design and integration solutions to improve maintenance operation and reduce risk of human error.
- Contribution to maintenance procedures development & demonstration on helicopter for validation.
- Presentation to internal stakeholders, external authorities and customers.
- Project management (cost, time, quality), including budget & consumption, planning and risk identification & mitigation.
- Interaction with various departments in Design Office, Prototype Shop, Service & Support and Quality organisations.

Desired skills and qualifications

- You are an Aerospace or Mechanical engineer or a certified aircraft engineer with 5 to 10 years of experience.
- Good communication skills and know how to communicate with different stakeholders.
- Dynamic, organized and accountable, you do not hesitate to go beyond your perimeter to reach your objective.
- Experience in helicopter systems and helicopter maintenance.
- Maintainability and ergonomic human factors analysis may be performed digitally (CATIA or Virtual Reality) or on Helicopter through test.
- Basic knowledge on CATIA V5 is essential.
- Knowledge on ergonomics would be appreciated.
- Fluent English is essential to evolve in the international environment.

- Design of satellite missions with Space Situational Awareness (SSA) and Space Intelligence context.
- Analysis of satellite platforms, sub-systems and payloads.
- Simulation, analysis and optimization of different mission scenarios and assessment of mission performance.
- Design and Implementation or improvement of software tools used for the simulation and analysis of SSA systems and missions.
- Supporting work for running projects within the domain of space safety and security.

- Enrolled full time Master student (d/f/m) in space or aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, automation engineering, physics, mathematics, software engineering or related fields.
- Strong background in orbital mechanics, AOCS and/or mission analysis.
- Experience in programming (Python) and with dedicated mission analysis tools (e.g., STK, Orekit, GMAT).
- Strong communicative skills and positive attitude towards teamwork.
- Fluent English, good German skills would be beneficial.
- Interest in Space Situational Awareness topics and space in general.
- Knowledge in optics and image processing and control technology will be an addition.

jobs.occupation: Scientific Project Manager - International EU Consortium in part-time (50%) (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

The Junior Clinical Cooperation Unit "Multiparametric Methods for Early Detection of Prostate Cancer" is seeking, starting at the earliest date possible, a Scientific Project Manager - International EU Consortium in part-time (50%).

The Junior Clinical Cooperation Unit “Multiparametric Methods for Early Detection of Prostate Cancer”, led by PD Dr. med. Magdalena Görtz, operates at the interface of the DKFZ and the Department of Urology at Heidelberg University Hospital. Our interdisciplinary team integrates clinical research, medical imaging, and machine learning to develop clinically relevant tools for individualized cancer detection and risk stratification.

PROMETHEUS is a DKFZ-led international research consortium on AI agents funded through the European Innovation Council Pathfinder program. The project brings together leading clinical and scientific institutions (DKFZ, Heidelberg University Hospital, Erasmus MC, Karolinska Institutet, Radboud University Medical Center and Umeå University).

We are seeking an experienced and highly committed scientific project manager to support the DKFZ in the successful implementation of this ambitious four-year European consortium at the intersection of cancer research, clinical medicine and trustworthy AI.

Your Tasks

- Organize general assemblies, meetings, workshops and regular consortium calls
- Prepare agendas and ensure consistent follow-up

- Support the preparation of scientific-technical reports and documentation for the European Commission
- Coordinate contributions from partners and ensure timely, complete and high-quality submissions
- Support quality assurance, risk management and compliance with consortium and funding requirements
- Work closely with DKFZ administration and external project-management experts on financial and organizational processes
- Contribute to stakeholder engagement, dissemination activities and a constructive, collaborative consortium culture

Your Profile

We are looking for an excellent project manager with a scientific background, strong interpersonal skills and a genuine interest in enabling ambitious international research.

- Master's degree, preferably in life sciences, medicine, public health, biomedical sciences, data science or a related field
- Relevant experience in managing collaborative research projects, ideally within Horizon Europe or another international funding program
- Strong understanding of scientific processes and the ability to communicate effectively with clinicians, researchers, data scientists and administrative teams
- Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines and stakeholders simultaneously
- Outstanding written and spoken English, German language skills are advantageous

jobs.occupation: Business Systems Architect (m/f/d) (Business-Analyst/in)
jobs.description:
TYTAN Technologies

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

We are looking for a Business Systems Architect (m/f/d) to own and evolve the systems, tools, and processes that keep TYTAN running. As a company that designs and manufactures its own hardware and software, our operational landscape spans engineering, production, supply chain, and beyond, all of which need to be reflected in a coherent, well-connected tool and process architecture. With Odoo as our core ERP platform today, you will ensure our systems work seamlessly together, our processes are well-designed and continuously improving, and our digital landscape is ready for the next stage of growth.

You will work closely with teams across the organization to translate business needs into smart, scalable workflows, and then build them.

Systems Architecture & Roadmap

- Build and maintain the enterprise architecture across business capabilities, processes, data, and applications, building a lean digital thread from Requirements and Engineering through to Production and Service.
- Define and enforce standards across the stack: single source of truth, SSO, clean integrations, and compliance with ISO 27001, ISO 9001, and Export Control requirements.
- Anticipate when the current tool landscape needs to evolve, knowing when Odoo alone is not enough and when dedicated PLM, MES, or other systems are needed.

Odoo Development & Customization

- Configure, customize, and extend Odoo modules using Python to match evolving business needs, owning upgrades, testing, and deployment across environments.
- Ensure data integrity, security, and performance of the Odoo platform while managing integrations with tools across CRM, finance, project management, and communication.

Engineering, Production & Process

- Support and optimize workflows for BOM management, production planning, work orders, and quality control, ensuring system processes reflect how hardware and software are actually built.
- Work with stakeholders to map, document, and improve business processes eliminating bottlenecks, reducing manual workarounds, and maintaining documentation as the business evolves.
- Manage product lifecycle processes from prototyping and engineering changes through to serial production, while ensuring full traceability and documentation standards are met.

AI & Automation

- Identify and implement AI and automation opportunities from Odoo's built-in capabilities to third-party tools and custom solutions to reduce manual work and improve accuracy
- Stay current on emerging AI and automation technologies and bring relevant ideas to the table

Stellenanforderungen

- 3–5 years of experience with ERP systems, with hands-on Odoo experience strongly preferred
- Solid Python development skills and familiarity with Odoo's OWL framework for customization and module development
- Proven experience mapping, documenting, and improving business processes with a strong understanding of how sales, procurement, inventory, production, and finance translate into system workflows
- Background in a manufacturing, engineering, or hardware-building environment is a strong plus
- Experience building and maintaining integrations between business systems via APIs, middleware, or native connectors, you see the full landscape and know how the pieces fit together
- Familiarity with AI/ML tools and workflow automation platforms such as n8n, Make, or Zapier
- Awareness of ISO 27001, ISO 9001, and export control compliance in a systems context;
- Clear communicator with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; fluent in English, German is a plus

Why TYTAN?

- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security.
- Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale.
- Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors.
- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback.
- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact.
- Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company.
- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe.

Our Benefits

- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation
- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit
- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us
- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team
- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together
- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands
- Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

(Senior) IT Risk & Compliance Specialist (f/m/d)

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

What you'll build:

SAP SS&D (Sovereign Services & Delivery) is looking for an IT Risk & Compliance Specialist (f/m/d) to operate, audit, and further develop the secure infrastructure at our Walldorf location.

In this role, you will serve as the central authority for IT risk management, compliance assurance, and audit coordination within our highly secure operational environment. You will ensure risk-compliant governance of the local IT landscape — including the on-site Micro Data Center — with a strong emphasis on BSI IT-Grundschutz implementation, ISO 27001 adherence, and regulatory alignment.

Your responsibilities span strategic compliance planning and hands-on operational delivery: conducting internal and external audits, maintaining ISMS documentation, driving continuous improvement of the security and compliance posture, and ensuring all systems meet the strictest confidentiality and regulatory requirements for public sector and regulated industry customers.

You will act as a trusted advisor and liaison for compliance- and security-related matters at the Walldorf site, engaging with internal stakeholders, external auditors, and government authorities.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

- Leading IT compliance, audit, and GRC activities in accordance with BSI IT-Grundschutz, ISO 27001, and applicable regulatory requirements
- Preparing, conducting, and following up on audits, including evidence collection, remediation tracking, and coordination with auditors, certification bodies, and authorities
- Creating and maintaining audit-ready IT security and compliance documentation, including IT-Grundschutz and ISMS artefacts, security concepts, risk registers, operating procedures, meeting minutes, and workshop summaries
- Preparing and delivering presentations, management briefings, decision papers, and structured reports on technical, security, compliance, and project-related topics
- Identifying, assessing, documenting, and mitigating operational IT risks and supporting security accreditation processes for classified environments
- Operating and maintaining secure IT infrastructure, including virtualized environments, Active Directory, access controls, backup and recovery, hardened clients, and IT asset management
- Using SIEM solutions, to analyze logs, detect anomalies, and support incident response and forensic activities
- Supporting procurement processes by identifying requirements, coordinating with stakeholders and vendors, and initiating orders when required
- Acting as a central interface between collaborating departments by consolidating requirements, coordinating cross-functional topics, clarifying responsibilities, and ensuring effective information flow
- Coordinating external service providers and acting as the local contact for auditors, customers, stakeholders, and government authorities, including conducting infrastructure tours and technical walkthroughs

What you bring:

You are a committed and proactive IT Risk & Compliance Specialist with a strong background in secure infrastructure operations, regulatory frameworks, and audit management. Your profile should demonstrate experience in several of the following areas:

- Master's degree (or equivalent) in IT, cybersecurity, information security management, or a related field — alternatively, completed vocational training as an IT specialist (Fachinformatiker) with substantial relevant professional experience
- 4+ years of relevant working experience in IT risk, compliance, or secure IT operations
- Strong expertise in Governance, Risk Management & Compliance and Auditing Support — including hands-on experience with BSI IT-Grundschutz, ISO 27001, gap analyses, ISMS implementation, audit preparation, evidence management, and remediation tracking
- Solid understanding of Operational Risk Mitigation and Cyber Security — from identifying and treating IT risks systematically to working with BSI-certified products, secure IT architectures, SIEM platforms (ideally Splunk), and classified environments
- Proven Project Management skills — ability to plan and drive compliance and infrastructure projects independently, on time, and within defined governance frameworks
- Familiarity with AI tools in a professional context: experience applying AI-assisted automation and prototyping, agentic workflows, and context engineering to operational or compliance tasks — paired with a critical eye for AI output quality assurance and the ability to drive AI adoption within the team
- Strong communication and stakeholder skills — excellent written and spoken German and English, with the ability to build trust with internal teams, external auditors, and government authorities, and to translate complex regulatory topics into clear, actionable language for diverse audiences
- Emotional intelligence and customer orientation — empathetic and composed under pressure, with a genuine focus on delivering value and clarity to all stakeholders, even in sensitive or high-stakes situations
- Complex problem-solving mindset — structured and analytical, with the ability to diagnose root causes, evaluate trade-offs, and drive sustainable solutions in ambiguous environments

jobs.occupation: BTA (m/w/d) (Chemisch-technische/r Assistent/in)
jobs.description:
(Senior) Research Associate - Protein Science (gn)
Antibody Discovery & Development · Martinsried / Munich · Full-time

About us
iOmx Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech company in the field of immuno-oncology, located in Martinsried/Munich, Germany. We are focused on the development of novel biomarker-supported cancer immunotherapies and are propagating an evolving pipeline of powerful multifunctional antibodies and T cell engagers. We are looking for highly motivated, self-driven and competent colleagues who share our vision and want to help turn it into reality. As part of our Protein Science team within the Antibody Discovery and Development Department, you will focus on the expression of recombinant proteins, antibodies and multispecific molecules in mammalian expression systems. You will advance the development of our transient expression platform, driving the discovery and development of innovative large-molecule biopharmaceuticals. Your responsibilities will include:

Plan and execute transient transfections in HEK and CHO - at various research scales
Develop and optimize our transient expression platforms: process, scale-up, yield, and quality
Run the molecular biology behind it: cloning and plasmid DNA prep at transfection scale
Contribute to construct design and feasibility assessment
Step in as dedicated backup for protein purification and downstream processing
Support analytics: characterization of recombinant proteins using state-of-the-art biochemical and biophysical methods (SDS-PAGE, LAL assay, HPLC)
Take responsibility for protein science lab equipment and infrastructure
Carefully evaluate, interpret, and document results in electronic lab journals and databases
Present data in internal meetings
You are the ideal candidate for this position if you bring the following:

You hold a vocational qualification as CTA, BTA, MTA or an equivalent university degree in a relevant field; at least 4 years of professional laboratory experience is preferred
You have in-depth experience in mammalian cell culture and transient transfection (HEK, CHO)
You have solid experience in cloning and molecular biology techniques; experience in construct design is a plus
You consider downstream processing and adjacent analytical methods as a welcome variety of your daily business
You pay attention to detail in experimental execution and documentation and have solid knowledge of relevant lab techniques and equipment, as well as standard laboratory and MS Office software
You are a well-organized, reliable team player with a hands-on mentality and strong communication skills
You work independently and efficiently, and adapt quickly to changing demands in a collaborative environment
You are proficient in English, both spoken and written
We are a clinical-stage biotechnology company with around 45 employees, driven by a shared purpose: to transform cancer treatment for patients. We work with flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes, in a welcoming and trusting environment where real progress comes from working together. What you can expect from us:

Work that matters: your work feeds directly into our pipeline of cancer immunotherapies, from multifunctional antibodies to T cell engagers on their way to the clinic
Real impact in a small team: your work is visible and you take on responsibility early
A culture of curiosity, integrity, and collaboration: we value diverse perspectives, open communication, and a hands-on mindset, in an environment where people grow together
On top of that: 30 days of vacation, flexible working hours, and support for a job bike or Deutschlandticket
